title: h4ckf0r0day/obscura
claim: h4ckf0r0day/obscura — The headless browser for AI agents and web scraping
why_good: A headless browser purpose-built for AI agents and scraping — agents constantly need reliable, stealthy web access and current tools fight bot-detection poorly.
value: Usage-based browser-as-a-service for agent builders (like Browserbase): pay per session/page, upsell proxies + anti-bot.
risk: Browserbase, Browserless and the vendors are here already; winning needs reliability, anti-detection and price at scale.
pick_reason: The project offers a specific tool for AI agents to scrape dynamic web content, which can be monetized as a software product.

zh.claim: h4ckf0r0day/obscura —— 给 AI agent 和网页抓取用的无头浏览器。
zh.why_good: 专为 AI agent 和抓取打造的无头浏览器——agent 时刻需要可靠、隐蔽的网页访问,而现有工具对抗反爬做得差。
zh.value: 给 agent 开发者做按量的浏览器即服务(类似 Browserbase):按会话/页计费,upsell 代理 + 反反爬。
zh.risk: Browserbase、Browserless 和各厂商已经在场;要赢得靠可靠性、反检测和规模化价格。
